scope: shared technical GUI accessibility and fallback checks relevant to stabilization presentation

source_contract.technical_boundary: docs/history/initiatives/visual-audio/visual-audio-phase10-accessibility-v0.12.26.md: These checks are technical interface proxies

checks.coverage: Skip link, stable presentation landmarks, focus-visible controls, and targeted live regions.
Visible status labels, symbols/patterns, accessible labels, and source-bound status metadata.
Large text, written-equivalent preference, reduced motion, and local storage fallback boundaries.
Committed resolution stages and host handoff remain written and recoverable during local pacing.
Mute, unavailable audio, setup failure, and playback failure preserve visible/text meaning.
Shared campaign debrief, audio, adapter, and host-projection presentation fields retain written fallbacks.

presentation_surface.current_shared_contract: The shared GUI contract covers technical keyboard, focus, text, non-color, reduced-motion, text-scale, written-equivalent, and optional-audio fallback behavior for supplied actor-visible projections.
presentation_surface.stabilization_boundary: The current stabilization CLI remains text-first; the live GUI launcher supports competitive-regional-v1 only, so no browser-native stabilization accessibility flow is certified.
presentation_surface.settings_ownership: Text scale, reduced motion, and written-equivalent preferences are local presentation state and do not enter commands, transitions, randomness, history, hashes, or debrief output.

open_work: contrast, viewport, screen-reader, assistive-technology, and device review
lived human accessibility and usability review
limits: Technical interface proxies do not establish human accessibility, lived usability, contrast certification, screen-reader behavior, assistive-technology compatibility, or hardware performance.
The shared checks do not certify an unlaunched browser-native stabilization flow; the live GUI remains competitive-regional-v1 only.
No new accessibility behavior, route, runtime field, asset, audio file, screenshot, persistence, instructor view, or authority path is created or promoted.
Written equivalents and reduced-motion behavior preserve meaning but do not establish learning, educational effectiveness, or policy validity.
No public-release, cross-browser certification, or human-review claim is made.
